newsitem.title: THAILAND: Ch Karnchang gets Thai police contract.
newsitem.headline: Ch Karnchang gets Thai police contract.

text.p: Thai construction firm Ch Karnchang said on Wednesday it, and its subsidiary Ch Karnchang-Tokyu, have signed a 754.8 million baht (US$30 million) deal with the Royal Thai Police to build a new department headquarters.
Construction on the Patuwan site starts this week and is scheduled to be completed within 25 months, according to a company spokesman.

Ch Karnchang owns 55 percent of Ch Karnchang-Tokyu, the remainder is held by Tokyu Construction. Ch Karnchang, one of Thailand's largest construction firms, has secured several other state building contracts in the past.
